manifest.name: dsh-theme-neko
manifest.description: A Nachoneko (甘城猫猫) themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, featuring the artist's artwork as the wallpaper background.

bundle.text:
# dsh-theme-neko bundle patch: inserts its dshClient row into the web plugin roster.
# Install with `dsh plugin add <path-or-git-url-or-npm-name>`; the plugin then
# appears in Settings -> Plugins.
- insert:
    - id: ui-skin-neko
      name: 'dsh-theme-neko'

readme.text: A **Nachoneko (甘城猫猫)** themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md) The interface uses the Nachoneko artwork by Amashiro Natsuki as the wallpaper background and applies a matching blue-and-white color palette.

- Nachoneko wallpaper background, with light and dark variants
- Interface surfaces styled to match the artwork's palette, including the
  composer, popup menus, and the settings dialog
- Readability adjustments for tooltips, focus indicators, and buttons

Install the plugin into your profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-neko
```

Restart the web GUI so the plugin is loaded:

```sh
dsh web
```

The theme is applied automatically after the restart.

- The plugin appears under Settings > Plugins as `dsh-theme-neko`.
- To replace the wallpaper, overwrite `assets/wallpaper.png`, then rebuild and
  reinstall the package.
- To uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-neko
```

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
npm publish
```
